name: Märchen
source:
The Magician of March / The Dream Magician

A being who watches over the dream world, Märchen protects everyone in the world from dying in their dreams and being drawn too deeply into them. Everyone has met Märchen multiple times when dreaming, but you always end up forgetting, just like how you forget your dreams. Despite this, Märchen is resolute to always lend you an ear and soothe you after a harsh day in reality.

Always patient and never judgmental no matter what they might see in someone's dreams or the depths of their minds, Märchen only wishes to make humanity just a bit kinder by being kind first. Märchen sees the heart of mankind in its purest form in the dream world, where the scars from the real world are laid to rest.

Märchen has no arms or legs (they have telekinesis/levitation powers instead), but can materialize them if necessary.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/2819459.m-rchen]official bio[/url]]
